units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:2">Snh. VII, 2</cite> <he>וחוֹמֶרֶת את וכ׳</he> and parches his entrails; (Ar., v. <cite ref="H01144"><he>חָמַד</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:3">Ḥull. III, 3</cite> <he>נפלה לאור ונֶחְמְרוּ וכ׳</he> if the bird fell into fire, and (on examination after slaughtering it was found that) its bowels were affected by inhaling heat (Ar., v. <cite ref="H01144"><he>חָמַד</he></cite>).
